concerns.text: FR-001 (load dataset) and FR-011 (validate completeness) lack a specific task to implement the actual dataset loading and completeness validation logic in `code/data/preprocess.py`. T014 only mentions 'computing basic stats' and does not explicitly cover the extraction of diffs/comments/timestamps or the ≥95% completeness check logic required by the spec.

FR-003 (compute complexity metrics) relies on T016, but the task description is truncated/ambiguous regarding the integration of `radon` for cyclomatic complexity and LOC. The spec requires these metrics for FR-010 (covariates), and the current task text does not clearly ensure the generation of valid complexity metrics for all supported languages.

FR-015 (manual audit) and SC-009 (heuristic accuracy) are blocked by missing implementation tasks. T017c (ingest human-labeled CSV and calculate accuracy) is marked as unchecked `[ ]` and depends on T017d (manual step). There is no automated task to validate the existence/format of the labeled CSV before T017c runs, risking a pipeline crash if the manual step fails.

T008 (create output.schema.yaml) is marked as 'rejected' in the analyze report, yet T024, T025, and T026 in Phase 4 depend on this schema to define result formats for FR-005, FR-008, and FR-010. A valid task to create/fix this contract is missing from the current list.

FR-013 (Power Insufficiency error) and FR-014 (Data Completeness error) require the system to halt and write `error_report.json`. While T018 addresses this, it depends on the validation logic in T014/T017 which is currently broken/truncated. A dedicated task to implement the error-reporting logic (writing `error_report.json`) is not explicitly separated or verified as complete.
